name: BSS B2B Lock
summary: Shopify app that hides prices, products and pages from visitors until they log in or match a rule such as a customer tag or passcode, with a free plan.
best_for: Wholesale or private-sale Shopify stores that want to hide prices and Add to cart from everyone except tagged or logged-in buyers
skip_if: you need proof that the lock works on the storefront before you install, or you want one flat price with no plan names that differ between the listing and the app
honest_knock: Hiding prices needs a paid plan, so the free plan only covers the website lock. The plan on our approval screen was called "Advanced Version" at $9.99, while the listing calls $9.99 "Basic Shopify". The app edits your theme, and removing the lock needs a clean-up step before you uninstall.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-22 on apps.shopify.com/login-to-access-pages) Free plan: lock the entire website by condition, free setup help from BSS support; upgrade to hide products and prices. Basic Shopify is $9.99 a month or $95.88 a year, Grow Shopify is $24.99 a month or $239.88 a year and Advanced Shopify is $49.99 a month or $479.88 a year, each with a 7 day free trial. All charges are billed in USD every 30 days. On our development store Shopify showed Advanced Version (Monthly) as a test charge of $9.99 every 30 days and we paid nothing.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 21 November 2026 on a Shopify development store with the Basic plan, in the real admin with the interface in English. We installed BSS B2B Lock from its Shopify App Store page, saved one lock rule that hides prices from customers without a VIP tag and opened the plan approval screen. The rule was saved about 3.5 minutes after pressing Install. Shopify marked the plan as a test charge that is not billed, so we paid nothing.
findings: Install: the Shopify dialog asked for view access to customer data, device and activity data, and staff and contributor data, and to view and edit customers, products, orders, Shopify Functions, the Online Store and custom data.

Lock rule: we created "My first lock" in three steps. The lock target was all products with the option "Price hidden - Add to cart visible but disabled", the rule was "Customer tag" with the tag VIP, and we excluded no pages. The app showed "Lock created successfully!" and listed the lock as on, with the target "Price".
Theme: the app told us "Code is added to your theme for store protection", so it changed the theme itself. We did not look at the storefront to see the hidden price.

Plan: the approval screen showed "Advanced Version (Monthly)" at $9.99 every 30 days with a 7 day free trial ending on 28 November, and the line "You will not be billed for this test charge". No card was asked for. The Shopify App Store listing calls the $9.99 plan "Basic Shopify", so the names differ between listing and app.
Removal: the app warns that you must switch off all rules on its Theme Cleanup page to remove the lock code from every theme. We did not uninstall.
not_tested: Not tested: whether the lock works for a VIP customer, the storefront view, passcodes, age checks and the higher plans.
Not tested: paying. Shopify showed a test charge on our development store, so we cannot say how the trial converts or what a real invoice looks like.
